items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Francis Murray tells some real great stories about this band that worked with him a lot. Supposed to have been a great guy.

ctx.x: I don't know. Did you work with Joe Clessie? No, but I believe my brother-in-law, Freddie Lloyd Cannon, said that he used to play some jaffers with him. I don't remember him ever playing any jaffers with Joe Clessie.
It's supposed to have been quite a band. Yeah. Francis Murray tells some real great stories about this band that worked with him a lot. Supposed to have been a great guy.

Well, the composers, speaking of the composers, Nick, Red Long was really one of the prime composers that I know of. And, of course, I don't remember too many of the other piano players that were composers outside of Joe Burgess and Earl and Claire. I can't think of any piano players offhand who were composers. Of course, we all know, you know, Pierre-Hong, or Pierre-Hong. Steve Lewis wrote some nice stories.
